subject: Taxes
title: Crypto Mixers and Tax Evasion
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Crypto Mixers and Tax Evasion.

hook.text: Crypto mixers blend thousands of transactions together to hide the trail.

buildup.text: Mixers work by pooling funds from many users, shuffling them, and sending different coins back.

discovery.text: In 2022, the US Treasury sanctioned Tornado Cash—the first time a government banned a piece of code.

twist.text: The developer was arrested in the Netherlands. Writing open-source privacy code became a criminal act.

climax.text: Mixer bans reveal the clash between privacy rights and tax enforcement.

quiz.question: Why was Tornado Cash sanctioned by the US?
options: It was used to hide billions in transactions from authorities
